title: InspectScenePayload
description: The payload of an inspect_scene job: deliberately EMPTY and closed. Everything the read needs is already trusted job identity — the project is job.project_id, resolved to a filesystem location by the worker's own registry, so a path is not representable here any more than it is in a mutation payload. There is no object selector, no filter, no query, and no field a model could populate: inspect_scene reads the whole scene or fails. Keeping the payload empty rather than omitting it preserves job.schema.json's invariant that every job_type binds to exactly one payload schema, so a Job is never an untyped dictionary. inspect_scene is the only READ job type in the canonical job-type enum (see job-type.schema.json for the read/mutating classification).
